newsitem.title: JAPAN: Cosmo Oil considering electricity sales.
newsitem.headline: Cosmo Oil considering electricity sales.

text.p: Cosmo Oil Co Ltd said on Monday it is considering taking part in a tender later this year to provide electricity wholesale as part of its efforts to improve profits.
A company spokesman said the tender Cosmo is considering will be held by Chubu Electric Power Co Inc in August.
If awarded the contract, Cosmo Oil would construct a power generator with capacity of around 300,000 kilowatts in the Yokkaichi area of central Japan, he said.
Japan's oil industry, suffering slumping profits mostly due to low profit margins on retail gasoline sales, has been eager to make use of surplus residual fuel to produce electricity for sale.
Nippon Petroleum Refining Co Ltd, a subsidiary of Nippon Oil Co Ltd, and Kyushu Oil Company Ltd were awarded contracts last year to supply electricity to two separate power utilities.
